articles.title: HSBC plans India equity broking return after 13 years amid IPO boom, sources say
articles.content: After a decade-long hiatus, HSBC is gearing up to re-enter the Indian equity broking sector, responding to the increasing demands from wealthy clients and an active share sale market. With this move, HSBC aims to enhance its equities platform and tap into the growing retail investor segment in India’s wealth management landscape.

articles.title: India bonds pummelled after Treasury rout, traders raise rate hike bets
articles.content: Indian government bonds experienced a decline following increases in U.S. Treasury yields and oil prices. Market participants anticipate a repo rate hike on October 7 due to economic conditions.
